description:
If your goal is to make your product shots stand out without a massive studio budget, this video is for you! @AlexeiDelaCuesta  shares how he uses the #AdobeStock panel in #Premiere to quickly elevate his product shots with grungy textures, overlays, and other Stock assets—searching, previewing, and licensing everything without ever leaving his project. 

Do you plan on trying this out for yourself? Let us know! 👇
title: Level up your product shots fast with the Adobe Stock Panel in Premiere | Adobe Creative Cloud
